title: Revelation Bible Quiz - Chapter 9
description: Ten questions on Revelation 9: the fifth and sixth trumpets, the locusts out of the abyss and the armies of horsemen.

questions.text: What was given to the star that had fallen from the sky to the earth?
questions.explanation: The fifth angel sounded, and the key to the pit of the abyss was given to the star that had fallen to the earth.

answers.text: A golden censer full of incense
A sharp sickle for the harvest
A balance for weighing grain
The key to the pit of the abyss

questions.text: What came up out of the pit of the abyss when it was opened?
questions.explanation: Smoke went up out of the pit, like the smoke from a burning furnace, and the sun and the air were darkened because of it.

answers.text: Water flowing out like a river
Smoke, as from a burning furnace
Fire mixed with hail and blood
A cloud with a rainbow on it

questions.text: Whom were the locusts allowed to hurt?
questions.explanation: They were told not to hurt the grass, nor any green thing, nor any tree, but only those people who don’t have God’s seal on their foreheads.

answers.text: Only the kings and princes of the earth
Only those who had the mark of the beast
Only those without God’s seal on their foreheads
Everyone who lives on the earth

questions.text: For how long were the locusts given power to torment people?
questions.explanation: They were given power not to kill, but to torment people for five months, and their torment was like the torment of a scorpion.

answers.text: Five months
Forty-two months
Three and a half days
Half an hour

questions.text: What were the shapes of the locusts like?
questions.explanation: The shapes of the locusts were like horses prepared for war, with something like golden crowns on their heads and faces like people’s faces.

answers.text: Like frogs coming out of a mouth
Like a leopard with a lion’s mouth
Like serpents with heads on their tails
Like horses prepared for war

questions.text: What is the name of the king over the locusts in Greek?
questions.explanation: They have over them as king the angel of the abyss, whose name in Hebrew is “Abaddon”, but in Greek he has the name “Apollyon”.

answers.text: Abaddon
Wormwood
Apollyon
Megiddo

questions.text: What did the voice from the horns of the golden altar tell the sixth angel to do?
questions.explanation: The voice said to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, “Free the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates!”

answers.text: Pour out his bowl on the great river
Free the four angels at the river Euphrates
Seal up what the seven thunders said
Measure God’s temple and the altar

questions.text: What was the number of the armies of the horsemen?
questions.explanation: John says the number of the armies of the horsemen was two hundred million, and that he heard the number of them.

answers.text: Two hundred million
One hundred forty-four thousand
Twelve thousand
One thousand six hundred

questions.text: By which three plagues was one third of mankind killed?
questions.explanation: One third of mankind was killed by the fire, the smoke and the sulfur which proceeded out of the mouths of the horses.

answers.text: By the sword, famine and wild animals
By hail, blood and darkness
By the fire, the smoke and the sulfur
By sores, heat and thirst

questions.text: Besides their murders and their sorceries, of what else did the rest of mankind refuse to repent?
questions.explanation: They didn’t repent of their murders, their sorceries, their sexual immorality, or their thefts.

answers.text: Their lies and their false oaths
Their sexual immorality and their thefts
Their wars and their heavy taxes
Their feasts and their drunkenness
